status_definitions.VERIFIED: Current evidence proves the capability or state in the checked scope.
status_definitions.PRESENT: Current repository contains implementation/configuration, but live operation is not proven.
status_definitions.CONFIGURED: A configuration/contract exists; configuration is not evidence of live connectivity.
status_definitions.HISTORICAL: Preserved prior record; not current runtime truth.
status_definitions.PROPOSED: Design/plan exists but deployment or operation is not proven.
status_definitions.MISSING: Required implementation/evidence was not found in the checked scope.
status_definitions.UNMAPPED: A known item exists but ownership/identity/connection is unresolved.

rules: Never upgrade CONFIGURED/PRESENT to VERIFIED from filenames, screenshots, old Arena sessions or environment claims.
Never activate external providers, social publishing or monetization merely to satisfy an inventory.
Never print, commit or copy credentials/tokens.
Git snapshot replication is not application/runtime DR.
External integrations require live authenticated evidence before VERIFIED.
